messages:
Tara: Final check before I schedule the release post: target Mon 2026-04-20 09:00 PT. Need public changelog blurb, docs URL, benchmark callouts, and confirmation on embargo / canary timing. @Nate @Omar @Iris
Nate: We're doing canary 25% -> 100% over 2.5h. Feature flags: `dedicated-autoscale`, `optimize-suggestions`. Gate: smoke tests pass + no anomaly alerts for 15m.
Omar: Public docs ready at https://redwood.com/docs/releases/dedicated-optimize-apr2026. Added a one-paragraph intro and "how to enable" steps.
Iris: Messaging note: lead with stability + predictable costs. Marketing wants a succinct benchmark line for the post.
Nate: Perf: p4d cluster, conversational workload. Cost-per-token down ~19% median; latency stable. Recommend copy: "around 20% lower steady-state cost" and link to detailed appendix.
deploy-bot: deployment windows: staging 2026-04-19T02:00Z, prod canary 2026-04-20T16:00Z, prod full 2026-04-20T19:00Z
Tara: Embargo plan: lift once prod hits 50% canary. Can engineering confirm 50% by 16:45 PT?
Nate: Should be fine unless autoscaler throttles. I'll watch and alert #eng-oncall if it stalls.
Tara: Great. I'll prepare the social + blog drafts and share a PR for quick review by EOD today. (reaction :thumbsup:)
